plan.understanding: Add a top-mounted radiator filler neck with an open pouring passage and a separate cap that closes the neck.

subtasks.goal: Create the pouring section and its opening as one ordered boss-and-bore edit on imported radiator body s0. Isolate s0 from the other 19 imported bodies. Using measured upper plane z=266.7 and its normal [0,0,1], place the feature axis through [-88.9,100.0,*]. First construct a solid cylindrical boss of outside diameter 38.1 mm from z=266.7 to z=296.7 and fuse that solid boss only to s0. After the boss union succeeds, cut one coaxial 25.4 mm diameter cylindrical bore continuously from the boss end z=296.7 down to the measured radiator interior level z=257.175; this forms both the hollow neck and the opening through the top skin. Do not boolean against or otherwise alter s1-s19. Reassemble the untouched bodies with the edited s0. Verify that edited s0 is a valid solid and print the achieved center, measured axis, 38.1 mm outside diameter, 25.4 mm bore diameter, exterior neck base z=266.7, neck end z=296.7, and bore interior end z=257.175. Also print the volume after the boss union, the volume after boring, and the final net volume change versus original s0; the union must add material, the bore must remove material, and the final edit must retain positive net added volume.

Add the removable cap as one new, separate solid using coaxial cylinder primitives rather than a revolved sketch. In a free-standing coordinate system aligned with the measured filler-neck axis, place an outer cylinder at center X=-88.9 mm, Y=100.0 mm with axis [0,0,1], radius 22.225 mm, base Z=296.7 mm, and top Z=308.7 mm. Subtract a coaxial radius-19.05 mm cylindrical tool that extends slightly below Z=296.7 to avoid a coincident boolean boundary and terminates exactly at Z=304.7 mm. The result must therefore retain an underside-open Ø38.1 mm recess 8.0 mm deep and a 4.0 mm closed roof, with Ø44.45 mm exterior. Keep the result unfused from the filler neck and all 20 existing bodies, append only this cap solid to the imported assembly, and do not modify imported or previously accepted geometry. Validate the cap body independently of the pre-existing invalid aggregate: it must contain exactly one valid solid, have centerline [-88.9,100.0] along [0,0,1], seating Z=296.7 mm, top Z=308.7 mm, and bounding box [-111.125,77.775,296.7] to [-66.675,122.225,308.7]. The assembly solid count should increase by exactly one.
